mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1400K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.75% indicates tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment (UNRATE < 4%) is a persistent indicator of a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and GDP (GDPC1) is above $22T, the combined effect predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery, a rebound in retail sales (RSAFS) above $680B signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances when RSAFS > 680B in post-shock recovery regimes, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the spread between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL inflation rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) is a persistent indicator of monetary policy stance, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days when the spread is negative.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL < 0, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 155.5K signals labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 155.5K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) is above 100 and GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 2%, the combined effect predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to potential supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
